quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Completes Deployment of All 616 NVIDIA RTX PRO (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Runpod: QumulusAI completed deployment of 616 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Runpod under two reserved-capacity agreements combining one- and two-year terms; all 77 GPU nodes under the agreements are now active, with full deployment reached in August 2026, ahead of the agreements' original Sept. 1, 2026 target. The GPUs are served from QumulusAI's existing U.S. data center footprint, and Runpod (a GPU cloud marketplace for AI developers) will offer the capacity to its customers for production AI inference and agentic workloads. The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs extend QumulusAI's inference- and visualization-class compute alongside its NVIDIA Blackwell B300 and B200 fleet.
quarterly_data.figure: 616 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs across 77 GPU nodes, fully deployed in August 2026
